title: The First Victory
summary: Ha-Jun spares Captain Baek and shows him Tae-Jun's journal, exposing the Bureau Director's treason. Captain Baek allows Ha-Jun and Min-Jae to escape. As Arc 2 concludes at 25% Synchronization, an Envoy of the Demon Lords watches from the shadows, and the next Relic—Bone of the Forgotten—begins to resonate.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands panting in the rubble, raising his left hand: The crystalline blood spears pinning Captain Baek liquefy into scarlet streams.

panels.shot: blood absorbing into silver ring macro
panels.action: The scarlet streams flow smoothly back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, leaving Captain Baek free of physical restraint.

panels.shot: captain baek collapsing on one knee
panels.action: Captain Baek collapses to one knee, clutching his bleeding shoulder, staring up at Ha-Jun in absolute, stunned bewilderment.
Baek speaks in a hoarse, ragged voice: 'Kyun...? Tumne mujhe khatam kyun nahi kiya? Tumhare paas aakhri vaar tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Kyun...? Tumne mujhe maar kyun nahi diya?

panels.shot: hajun wiping blood tired human gaze
panels.action: Ha-Jun wipes scarlet blood from his split lip, looking at Baek with tired, profoundly human eyes: 'Kyunki mere bhai ne isliye jaan nahi di thi... taaki main ek darinda ban jaaun.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera bhai isliye nahi mara taaki main darinda banu.

panels.action: Baek freezes; the sincerity in the teenager's eyes pierces through seven years of hardened military conditioning.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh aawaz... bilkul Tae-Jun jaisi thi...

panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls Tae-Jun's leather journal from his shredded blazer pocket, tossing it onto the grass in front of Baek's knees.
Ha-Jun: 'Apne Bureau ke sach ko padho. Wo saat saal se tum sabko bewakoof bana rahe hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bureau ke sach ko padho. Wo tumse jhooth bol rahe hain.

panels.action: Baek opens the brittle pages with bloodstained trembling fingers; official Bureau directorate seals leap out from the text.
Close-up on the document: Official high-level authorizations for Project Chimera: Harvesting demonic relics for artificial soldier hybridization.

dialogue.text: 'Project Chimera: Authorized by Bureau High Command.'

panels.shot: baek scarred face twisting in bitter realization
panels.action: Baek's face pales: 'Director ne yeh approve kiya tha?! Saat saal pehle Tae-Jun gaddaar nahi tha... wo lab ko containment breach se bacha raha tha!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun gaddaar nahi tha... wo lab bacha raha tha!

panels.action: Baek lowers his head toward the mud: 'Maine us aadmi ke chote bhai ka shikar kiya... jisne mere logon ke liye apni jaan daav par laga di.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Maine Tae-Jun ke bhai ka shikar kiya...

panels.action: In the distance, tactical vehicle headlights and spotlights sweep across the tennis courts; shouting operatives draw near.
Baek looks up urgently: 'Reinforcements aa rahi hain. Apne dost ko lekar athletic building ke piche underground tunnel se bhaag jao.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Tunnel se nikal jao! Reinforcements aa rahi hain!

panels.action: Ha-Jun blinks in mild surprise: 'Tum humein jaane de rahe ho?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum humein jaane de rahe ho?

panels.action: Baek snaps his broken claymore back into his scabbard: 'Main report dunga ki carrier bhaag gaya aur Jun-Hyuk ne gaddaari ki. Ab jao!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Main report sambhaal lunga. Ab jao!

panels.action: Ha-Jun slings Min-Jae's arm around his neck, supporting his limping friend into the shadowed service maintenance tunnel.
Min-Jae smiles through his cracked glasses: 'Bhai... tumne Rank-A Captain ko hara kar use hamari madad karne par majboor kar diya.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Bhai... tumne sach mein Rank-A Captain ko hara diya!

panels.action: Ha-Jun chuckles softly: 'Pehle apartment pahunchne do... isse pehle ki mere pair jawab de dein.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on shoulder gaze up
panels.action: Kuro alights firmly on Ha-Jun's shoulder, his crimson eyes locking onto the high library tower roof: 'Ha-Jun... koi aur bhi humein dekh raha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... koi aur bhi humein dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: crimson masked figure on library roof wide
panels.action: 500 meters away atop the library spire: A shadowy figure wearing a porcelain crimson demon mask and black cape rests a scythe on his shoulder.

panels.shot: demonic perception zoom on masked figure
panels.action: Through his violet demonic perception, Ha-Jun zooms across the distance: The masked figure emits ancient, terrifying Abyssal wavelength.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh Hunter nahi hai... yeh Abyss ka koi Lord hai!

panels.action: The masked Envoy raises two gloved fingers to his temple, giving Ha-Jun a chilling, mocking salute before stepping off the ledge.

panels.shot: kuro terror warning envoy of lords
panels.action: Kuro whispers in cold dread: 'Wo Demon Lords ka Envoy hai! Abyss ke shikari dharti par utar chuke hain!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Demon Lords ka Envoy... wo aa chuke hain!

panels.action: The masked figure dissolves into thousands of screeching black demonic bats that scatter into the night sky over Seoul.

panels.shot: safe emergence on quiet residential street
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae emerge safely onto a quiet, wet residential street, distant sirens fading behind campus walls.

dialogue.text: Unhone pehli ladai jeet li thi.

panels.action: Royal purple system prompt chimes: [ARC 2: THE HIDDEN BLOODLINE — COMPLETED] | [SYNCHRONIZATION: 25.0%] | [NEW TITLE: SOVEREIGN OF HOLLOW BLOOD].

panels.shot: ring pulsing toward east observatory macro
panels.action: The Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger suddenly pulses with a directional resonance beacon pointing east toward the University Observatory.
System UI flashes: [NEXT RELIC DETECTED: BONE OF THE FORGOTTEN (BASIC)] | [LOCATION: EAST OBSERVATORY CRYPT].

dialogue.text: [NEW RELIC: BONE OF THE FORGOTTEN] [LOCATION: EAST OBSERVATORY]

panels.action: Grand Arc 2 finale spread: Ha-Jun Kang stands under yellow sodium streetlights, his ring glowing and eyes shining violet: 'Shikar shuru ho chuka hai. Agla nishana: Bone of the Forgotten.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Shikar shuru ho chuka hai. Agla nishana: Bone of the Forgotten.
